| description = One of King Tormax's most trusted agents, Derakor the Vindicator is responsible for exacting justice upon those who oppose or betray the Storm Giants. 

* Spawns in front of the Temple of Kael (located in the back of the Arena area).  
* Often accompanied by two [[a temple guardian]]s. Split, pull, and kill the guardians first. They will follow him wherever he goes, but are not aggro-linked to him or each other like pets. Because they always follow him, they may turn to face Derakor as he moves. They may also be kited while he is killed. Note: as soon as their aggro is cleared, they will run to Derakor's vicinity just like any other pet would do.   If vindi's corpse is fully looted, the guardians will stop walking to him.
* Scowling to all players, regardless of giant faction. 
* MR (35) CR (435) FR (45) PR (75) DR (75)

Also see: [[Vindi Raid Guide]]
